This is a private Complaint filed by Complainant for the offences punishable U/s U/s 418, 419, 420,
417, 354, 506(B), 120(B) of I.P.C.
After receipt of Complaint, the Complaint has been referred to the Kodigehalli Police U/s 156 (3) of Cr.P.C.

Thereafter, I.O., has investigated the matter and filed chargesheet against the accused Nos.1 to 4 for the offences punishable U/s 418, 419, 420, 417,
354, 506(B), 120(B) of I.P.C.
 3 C.C. No.10696/2016  2.
Brief case of the prosecution is as under :

It is alleged in the chargesheet that the complainant and one N D Ravi entered into Joint Development Agreement dated 06.03.2008, according which, both of them have to construct an apartment under the name of Dreamz Sadan Apartment and after construction, sites No.101, 102, 201, 202, 301, 302 fallen to share of said Ravi.

The complainant retained the rights to maintain Lift and Borewell of the said Apartment along with common space in the ground floor and as such, the complainant got obtained power supply from KEB in the year 2011 itself.
That being so

,
the accused No.1 and 2 purchased the site No.301 on 12.08.2011 through registered sale deed instead paying sale consideration, they playing fraud Chandrashekar vs Sritanwar Megharaj Chandwani on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/89679485/
2 postponing to pay sale consideration by one or the other reason and finally they did not pay sale consideration.

Such being the circumstance, in the last week of December 2014 when the complainant  4 C.C. No.10696/2016 and his sister Kalpana approached the accused No.1 and 2 requesting to pay sale consideration, but they did not pay it.

The accused No. 3 and 4 were the residents of apartment, colluded with accused No.1 and 2, cheated the complainant and thereby they committed the offenses U/s 418, 419, 420, 417, 354,
506(B), 120(B) of I.P.C.
 3.
Accused-1 to 3 are on bail.
As required u/sec. 207 of Cr.PC, the copies of the charge sheet papers were furnished to the accused-1 to 3.

Charge was framed for the offences punishable U/s 468, 471,
420 r/w 34 of I.P.C. and read over, explained to the accused in the known language of them.
Accused have not pleaded guilty and claimed for trial.

During trial, since accused No.4 remains absent regularly,
therefore, the case against him was split up.

In order to prove the case of the prosecution,

the prosecution has examined Pws.1 to 3 and got marked Ex.P.1 to 4.

On closure of the evidence on the side of the prosecution, the statement of the accused - 1 to 3 u/sec. 313 Cr.PC came to be recorded, they denied the incriminating evidence appeared against them and not chose to lead defence evidence.
5. Heard the arguments.
Perused the documents placed on record.

6. The points that arise for consideration are :
 1. Whether the prosecution has proved  beyond all reasonable doubt that  accused-1 to 3 have committed the  offences U/s 418, 419, 420, 417, 354,
 506(B), 120(B) of I.P.C. ?
 2. What order ?
 7.

The above points are answered as under :
 Point No.1: In the Negative.
Point No.2: As per final order for the following

:
 6 C.C. No.10696/2016  REASONS

8. Point No.1 : It is the case of the prosecution that the accused No.3 and 4 colluding with accused No.1 and 2 cheated the complainant without paying sale consideration and thereby they committed aforesaid offences.
Chandrashekar vs Sritanwar Megharaj Chandwani on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/89679485/
4  9.

In order to prove the guilt of the accused,
prosecution has examined the complainant as PW.1, in his evidence he deposed that he entered into Joint Development Agreement entered with Ravi for construction of apartment, according to which, both of them were entitled to half portion of said apartment,
after construction of apartment and some sites were fallen to share of developer.
The accused got electricity connection in the name of complainant and they did not pay sale consideration.

Further, deposed that on 02.02.2015 when the complainant and his sister Kalpana approached accused No.1 and 2, they hold  7 C.C. No.10696/2016 her hand and beaten her, accused No.3 and 4 torn saree of his sister by warning her that if she would come to their house they would rape her.

In the cross examination, PW.1 according to terms of joint agreement site No.301 fallen to Ravi's share, but there was another contract between him and Ravi, as per which, said site was fallen to the share of complainant, but no such contract is placed on record.
Further, he denied the suggestion that saree torn by the accused and no sale consideration is due from them.

10.CW.4 is the SHO examined as PW.2, in his Chandrashekar vs Sritanwar Megharaj Chandwani on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/89679485/
5 evidence he deposed that when he was in Police Station as SHO on 07.02.2015 he received complaint and registered the case as per Ex.4 FIR.

Thereafter, he conducted spot mahazar as per Ex.P.2 in the presence of witnesses and recorded the statements of CW.2,
CW.3 and handed over case file to CW.5 for further  8 C.C. No.10696/2016 investigation.
In the cross examination, PW.2 deposed that no notice was issued to pancha witnesses, denied the suggestion that he prepared mahazar at station and deposing false evidence.

11.CW.5 is the investigating officer examined as PW.3, in his evidence he deposed that after receipt of case file from CW.4 filed charge sheet against the accused, since the investigation had been completed.

12. This court has carefully perused the material on record, according to prosecution case, the accused No.3 and 4 colluding with accused No.1 and 3 not paid sale consideration and they torn the saree of complainant's sister Kalpana and warned her.

According to evidence deposed by the complainant as per Joint Agreement site No.301 was fell to Ravi's share, then it was fell to complainant's share as per Chandrashekar vs Sritanwar Megharaj Chandwani on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/89679485/
6 second agreement, but no such agreement is placed on  9 C.C. No.10696/2016 record.

Further, in the complaint it is not mentioned as to saree of complainant's sister torn by accused,
but, the PW.1 stated this fact in his evidence, so the evidence of PW.1 itself is contradictory and does not inspire confidence.
The evidence of PW.2 and 3 relates to investigation and that will not help the prosecution to prove guilt of accused.
Therefore, in view of the above discussion, the considered opinion of this court is, the prosecution has not been able to prove the offence alleged against accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Hence, the benefit of doubt is to be given to accused and therefore, this court has answered the above point in the Negative.
13. Point NO.2:- In the result, the following order is passed.

ORDER Acting U/s 248 (1) of Cr.P.C. the accused No.1 to 3 are hereby acquitted for the offence punishable U/s 418, 419, 420, 417, 354, 506(B), 120(B) of I.P.C.
Bail bonds of accused and their surety bonds stand cancelled after six months from today.
Office is hereby directed to keep this file along with split- up case, registered against accused-4.
